title: Red Flag Guidance
purpose: Provide safety-focused health navigation when a user reports potentially concerning symptoms.
medical_disclaimer: SakhiStep provides general health education and navigation only. It does not diagnose medical conditions, prescribe medicines, or replace professional medical advice.

guidance.title: Seek Urgent Medical Care
guidance.description: Recommend urgent medical evaluation when the user reports severe, rapidly worsening, or potentially serious symptoms.
examples: Severe weakness or feeling extremely unwell
Heavy or unusual bleeding accompanied by significant weakness or dizziness
guidance.action: Seek urgent medical care or emergency assistance.

guidance.title: Talk to a Healthcare Professional Soon
guidance.description: Persistent, worsening, unusual, or disruptive symptoms should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.
examples: Ongoing concerns that do not improve
guidance.action: Arrange an appointment with a qualified healthcare professional.

guidance.title: Monitor and Learn More
guidance.description: When no warning signs are reported and the concern appears mild, the user can monitor changes while learning about general health information.
guidance.action: Monitor the concern and consider discussing persistent changes with a healthcare professional.

guidance.title: More Information Needed
guidance.description: If the information provided is insufficient for safe guidance, SakhiStep should not guess or provide a diagnosis.
guidance.action: Ask relevant follow-up questions or recommend speaking with a qualified healthcare professional.

safety_rules: Do not diagnose a medical condition.
Clearly communicate uncertainty when information is insufficient.
Recommend professional care when symptoms may require evaluation.
Use simple, respectful, and easy-to-understand language.
